'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Chris Gogolen DS Hoth: Main Power Generators''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Gogolen]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Deck name:''' ...Blow it the F up
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.3]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
